lastCompletedStory.title: Structured deterministic result line for finalizeCycleClose

nextStoryContext: US-006 done: finalizeCycleClose now emits one structured emitOk result line on every code path. Happy path: emitOk with issue-id, removed file names (prd.json, handoff.json, progress.txt), and commit sha (from git rev-parse --short HEAD). GitHub/linear path: same line with backend note in parentheses. No-op paths (prd absent, nothing staged): emitOk with clear skip message instead of the old silent printHint. New tests in test/ship-finalize.test.ts capture stdout and assert the structured line is present. 1032 tests pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only used the existing internal emitOk helper from src/logging/screen.ts and printError from src/logging/color.ts. No new external library API was exercised.
